short: Logical qubits times T count for the simulation

lean.name: DynamicCircuit.count
lean.plain: T-gate count across measurements and conditionals
lean.annotation: Measurement contributes zero T gates, a conditional takes the maximum of its branch counts, and sequencing adds counts. If two conditionals use the same bit and their counts are $(4,0)$ and $(0,4)$, the structural count is 8 even though each execution uses 4 T gates.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.photochemistry_const_cost
lean.plain: Circuit spacetime bound and primitive Toffoli count
lean.annotation: The theorem bounds the structural T count of the program used in the correctness theorem by $100{,}444{,}225{,}133$. The proof can add one 76-T allowance per step from the existence proof for the rotation circuits without evaluating their gate words.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.photochemistryAncillas
lean.plain: 417 clean ancillas after removing idle wires
lean.annotation: The construction first uses a larger ancillary layout and then removes its idle wires. The retained count is $(62-23)+314+(62+2)=417$, which is the width required by `photochemistryProgram`. Adding the 5,616 system qubits gives $Q=6{,}033$.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.photochemistryConstCost
lean.annotation: The decimal numeral is the definition of `photochemistryConstCost`, the right-hand side of the resource inequality. The arithmetic lemma computes the same number from $Q$ and the per-step T-gate budgets, which explains why the inequality uses this particular integer.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.PhotochemistrySolution.WalkCostStack.hCost_stack_eq
lean.plain: Exact product of 6,033 qubits and the T-gate budget
lean.annotation: The equality evaluates $6{,}033[d(30{,}116+76)+2\cdot30{,}132+245]$ at $d=3{,}326{,}847$. The one-time term is a net allowance. The initial and final word bounds and the two phase-gradient operations contribute $76+73+2\cdot174$ T gates, and one 252-T reflection already included in the step allowances is omitted.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.photochemistry_const_cost
lean.plain: Circuit spacetime bound and primitive Toffoli count
lean.annotation: The first conjunct rules out primitive Toffoli gates, which would be counted separately from T gates. A temporary-AND compute, for example, contributes four T gates, and its measurement-based uncomputation contributes zero. The second conjunct multiplies the structural T count by all 6,033 logical qubits.
